name: team-relay
description: Ask teammates' Claude sessions questions and run named, parameterised operations for each other; answers are pushed into your session.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Base URL of your team relay (https; plain http only to localhost).

relay_team.title: Team
relay_team.description: Your team id on the relay, for example demo.

relay_auth.title: Relay sign-in
relay_auth.description: google (the default): your own gcloud identity, from `gcloud auth print-identity-token`. token: a static development token, for a local relay only.

gcloud_account.title: gcloud account
gcloud_account.description: Optional: the gcloud account (email) whose identity to use when signing in with google. Empty means gcloud's active account.

relay_token.title: Relay token
relay_token.description: Only when relay sign-in is token: your bearer token for a local relay. Stored in your system keychain, never in a file.

allow_production.title: Allow production-data capabilities
allow_production.description: Off unless you opt in. When off, capabilities that touch production data are never offered to teammates, whatever else is set. The answering session reads this as ALLOW_PRODUCTION.

cap_staging_db_query.title: Run Query the staging database for teammates
cap_staging_db_query.description: Staging data. Off by default unless the team manifest turns it on. The answering session reads this as CAP_STAGING_DB_QUERY_ENABLED.

cap_staging_db_query_runner.title: Program that runs Query the staging database
cap_staging_db_query_runner.description: Absolute path to the executable that runs staging_db_query; it gets one JSON line on stdin and prints one JSON value. The answering session reads this as CAP_STAGING_DB_QUERY_RUNNER.

cap_service_health.title: Run Check a service's health for teammates
cap_service_health.description: Staging data. Off by default unless the team manifest turns it on. The answering session reads this as CAP_SERVICE_HEALTH_ENABLED.

cap_service_health_runner.title: Program that runs Check a service's health
cap_service_health_runner.description: Absolute path to the executable that runs service_health; it gets one JSON line on stdin and prints one JSON value. The answering session reads this as CAP_SERVICE_HEALTH_RUNNER.

cap_production_db_count.title: Run Count rows in a production table for teammates
cap_production_db_count.description: Production data: offered only if you also allow production-data capabilities. Always off by default. The answering session reads this as CAP_PRODUCTION_DB_COUNT_ENABLED.

cap_production_db_count_runner.title: Program that runs Count rows in a production table
cap_production_db_count_runner.description: Absolute path to the executable that runs production_db_count; it gets one JSON line on stdin and prints one JSON value. The answering session reads this as CAP_PRODUCTION_DB_COUNT_RUNNER.
